Name: Cloudcutter
Author: duijiangyaoyue
Description:
[heading][b][color=#e4e4e7][size=2]A bamboo-cored blade that grows with every monster you slay.[/size][/color][/b][/heading]
Cloudcutter arrives on the first morning in a handwritten letter. It starts as a modest 10–15 damage sword, but every kill leaves a little more edge on the blade. Kills are stored on the weapon itself, so the sword you carry at hour one is the same sword that cuts through the late game.
Growth
[list]
[*]Kills accumulate whenever Cloudcutter is in your backpack — you do not need to hold it.[/*]
[*]Kills with other weapons, magic or bombs count too.[/*]
[*]Base damage rises from 10–15 to a full-investment target of [b]120–150[/b] (vanilla), [b]120–180[/b] (SVE) or [b]300–375[/b] (RSV).[/*]
[*]The target assumes red rarity, +10 enhancement, the Fury affix, three ruby forges and the prismatic shard step. Lower investment gives a lower panel.[/*]
[*]250 kills: lifesteal on hit.[/*]
[*]500 kills: Cloud Slash, a wide frost shockwave.[/*]
[*]1000 kills: mastery, shorter cooldown and the final stage sprite.[/*]
[/list]Forge and rarity
The craftable Cloudforge opens the same menu as the F shortcut.
[list]
[*]Six rarity colours: white ×0.8, green ×0.88, blue ×0.99, purple ×1.11, orange ×1.25, red ×1.5.[/*]
[*]Rarity and affix roll independently.[/*]
[*]Ten enhancement levels, each adding damage.[/*]
[*]Ten affixes: Sharp, Swift, Deadly, Heavy, Legendary, Warlord, Guardian, Gale, Fury and Celestial.[/*]
[*]Rerolls cost any one of copper, iron, gold or iridium bars, or a prismatic shard.[/*]
[*]Gem forges from the vanilla forge system are preserved.[/*]
[/list]Skills
Fifteen skills across three lines:
[list]
[*]Passives: Cloud Edge, Stargazer, Windchase, Springback, Mountain Rest.[/*]
[*]Actives: Cloudsever, Snowdrift, Sheathed Edge, Cloudstep, Cloudpull.[/*]
[*]Awakenings: Skyfrost, Moon Tide, Myriad Bloom, Dark Ice, Cloud Oath.[/*]
[/list]Press [b]Q[/b] to cast the equipped active. Press [b]G[/b] while holding Cloudcutter to open the loadout. Every skill has its own animation: arcs, rings, frost pillars, dash trails and sweeping waves.
Cloudstep is a six-tile dash that stops one tile before walls, water, objects and terrain.
Kill multiplier sigils
The Desert Trader sells four sigils that raise the kill-count multiplier:
[list]
[*]Twin Sigil ×2 — 50 copper bars.[/*]
[*]Triple Sigil ×3 — 50 iron bars.[/*]
[*]Quad Sigil ×4 — 50 gold bars.[/*]
[*]Quint Sigil ×5 — 20 iridium bars.[/*]
[/list]Each has a stock of one, can be used once, and must be used in order. The weapon panel shows the current multiplier.
Stage rewards
At 250, 500, 750 and 1000 kills you receive a skill book you have not learned yet. Once everything is learned, no more books are granted.
Compatibility
[list]
[*][b]SVE and RSV[/b] are detected automatically and adjust the full-investment damage target.[/*]
[*][b]The Covenant of the Ensouled Arms - Many Blades[/b] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54520]Nexus 54520[/url]) is recommended. If you enjoy sword spirits, dialogue and a bond system, Many Blades gives Cloudcutter a portrait and a story line; the two mods are designed to be used together.[/*]
[*]Existing saves keep their weapon and kill count. Legacy sword IDs migrate automatically.[/*]
[/list]Configuration
All keys can be rebound in GMCM. The menu is split into Overview, Growth and Balance, Unlocks and Lifesteal, Skills and Kill Chain, Keys, and Forge and Display.
Requirements
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, recommended)[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][color=#e4e4e7][size=2]一把随击杀成长的竹骨长刃。[/size][/color][/heading]
裁云会在第一天的信里送到你手上。它最初只有 10–15 伤害，但每斩一头怪物，刃上就多一分寒光。击杀数保存在武器本身，所以第一天拿到的那把剑，就是陪你打到后期的那把剑。
成长
[list]
[*]只要裁云在背包里，击杀就会累积，不需要手持。[/*]
[*]用其它武器、魔法或炸弹击杀也会计入。[/*]
[*]基础伤害从 10–15 成长到满配目标：原版 [b]120–150[/b]，SVE [b]120–180[/b]，RSV [b]300–375[/b]。[/*]
[*]满配目标按红色品阶、强化 +10、狂怒词缀、3 颗红宝石和五彩碎片计算；投入越低，面板越低。[/*]
[*]250 杀：攻击吸血。[/*]
[*]500 杀：裁云斩，范围霜色剑气。[/*]
[*]1000 杀：大成，冷却缩短，切换最终阶段立绘。[/*]
[/list]锻造与品阶
可制作的云纹锻台与 F 快捷键打开同一套菜单。
[list]
[*]六色品阶：白 ×0.8、绿 ×0.88、蓝 ×0.99、紫 ×1.11、橙 ×1.25、红 ×1.5。[/*]
[*]品阶与词缀独立随机。[/*]
[*]十级强化，每级提升伤害。[/*]
[*]十种词缀：锋利、迅捷、致命、重击、传奇、破军、守护、疾风、狂怒、天工。[/*]
[*]洗练可用铜锭、铁锭、金锭、铱锭或五彩碎片任选其一。[/*]
[*]原版锻造台的宝石强化会被保留。[/*]
[/list]技能
十五条技能，分为三系：
[list]
[*]被动：云锋、观星、逐风、回春、山止。[/*]
[*]主动：断云、回雪、敛锋、踏云、牵云。[/*]
[*]觉醒：天霜、月潮、万华、玄冰、云誓。[/*]
[/list]按 [b]Q[/b] 释放已装配的主动技能；手持裁云时按 [b]G[/b] 打开装配界面。每个技能都有独立动画：弧光、光圈、霜柱、冲刺光带与横扫光带。
踏云为 6 格冲刺，遇到墙、水、物件与地形会停在障碍前一格。
杀怪倍率符
沙漠商人出售四种符令，提高击杀计数倍率：
[list]
[*]双锋令 ×2 — 铜锭 50。[/*]
[*]三叠令 ×3 — 铁锭 50。[/*]
[*]四象令 ×4 — 金锭 50。[/*]
[*]五岳令 ×5 — 铱锭 20。[/*]
[/list]每种库存 1，每档限用 1 次，必须按顺序使用。武器面板会显示当前倍率。
阶段奖励
在 250、500、750、1000 杀时，各赠送一本尚未学会的技能书；全部学会后不再发放。
兼容性
[list]
[*][b]SVE 与 RSV[/b] 自动检测，并调整满配伤害目标。[/*]
[*][b]推荐搭配《灵兵契-万刃物语》[/b]（[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54520]N 网尾号 54520[/url]）。如果你喜欢剑灵、对话与羁绊系统，万刃会给裁云立绘与剧情线；两个模组可以一起使用。[/*]
[*]旧存档保留武器与击杀数，旧剑 ID 自动迁移。[/*]
[/list]配置
所有按键可在 GMCM 改绑。菜单分为总览、成长与平衡、解锁与吸血、技能与连斩、按键设置、锻造与显示。
前置
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 或更高[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu（可选，推荐）[/*]
[/list]
